tests: decompengine.repair.TraceGuidedRepairTest.active ACP repair admits the exact revision node count and refuses the next attempt before dispatch
command: DECOMP_REQUIRE_LIVE_ACP_CONTRACT=1 JAVA_OPTS='-Xmx8g' ./gradlew --offline test --console=plain -Pkotlin.compiler.execution.strategy=in-process -x verifyFrontendToolchain -x frontendInstall -x frontendBuild -x generateFrontendAssetManifest -x verifyFrontendAssets --tests 'decompengine.repair.TraceGuidedRepairTest.active ACP repair admits the exact revision node count and refuses the next attempt before dispatch'

scope.provider: scripted ACP process through the active repair loop
scope.coverage: The fresh graph starts with one root and maximumRevisionNodes=2. The first scripted ACP modification reaches the injected validator and leaves the graph with exactly two nodes and one run. A second repair call can begin its second run but is refused by beginAttempt with the exact revision-node-budget diagnostic before another ACP dispatch or validation; the terminal RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED run is retained. Assertions verify the node count remains at the ceiling, accepted source/head remain unchanged, no attempt is pending, and the first invocation receipt, assessment, process exit, and sandbox cleanup are bound and verified.
qualificationLimits: uses an injected validation strategy rather than production validation under #236
does not establish live-provider behavior or hosted exact-head CI
does not establish publication crash recovery under #732 or durable provenance under #733
other resource limits and the complete #734/#63 acceptance matrix remain open
